notes.title: Final Content Update
notes.content:
This is the last and final content update for RetroRange. Here going forward RetroRange will only receive updates for bugs or game-breaking issues.

Credits listing updated

788 Garage Studio will be moving on to a new project. Want to stay updated on developments join the Discord server https://discord.gg/STBxafC9jR

notes.title: UI updates!
notes.content:
UI improvements; Health bar, ammo counter, health flash, damage indicator, UI Buttons
Controls Options done button, within the game was not closing now fixed, & Add Esc Button configure to Rewired input system (Button Name Cancel)
Player could jump on the roof and jump out of bounds of the level using a collider to prevent jumping over the fence.
Wall target plates, moved higher so the player doesn't get stuck under them. 
Updated Sniper aiming bobble, less aggressive sway
Change Footprint Sounds & volume levels

notes.title: October 25th Build updates & fixes
notes.content:
Here is a list of a few bugs fixed and features implemented in the current build release.


The outdoor range is available in its current development progress.

Destructible vehicle

Both stereo and button spawn now use mouse-over action, you must look at the buttons to activate.

Esc the menu clicks on non-menu UI lose the Cursor; Added background UI image to prevent clicking on First person mouse cursor disable.

Tools falling out of the stage, fixed colliders

Targets spawn with bullet decals, fixed by removing decals and adding flash particles

Surfaces impacts with bullet impacts have been updated globally

Pistol spread has been reduced to smaller groups.
